name: After recital 1
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: (1a) The current adaptation and preparedness efforts in the Union and within the Member States are insufficient, largely incremental and belated to adequately address and respond to future climate and environment induced crises and emergencies. Healthcare systems in Member States are underprepared, understaffed and face underinvestment to prepare for the multiple, interacting and cumulative health impacts and threats caused by accelerating climate change and an ageing population. The Union and Member States should strengthen the preparedness efforts and increase the resilience of healthcare systems and of healthcare workforce well in advance to sufficiently prepare for growing risks, threats, emergencies and pressures, including climate related risks. The Commission should ensure the harmonisation of climate risk assessments across Member States, using common climate scenarios and methodological standards.
